Container.Name: Strata-AMD

Branch.TagDescription: RX 9000 series and Radeon AI PRO R9700 (RDNA 4)

Container.Overview:
Strata AMD runs the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next mixture-of-experts model on an AMD GPU plus system RAM, and serves an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API, a chat page and a live monitor. This template runs Strata's official image, ROCm build. For NVIDIA cards use the separate Strata template instead.
Before you press Apply: by default Strata also copies the model's experts into system RAM, even ones the GPU already holds. On a server that runs other containers this can use most of your memory (measured: about 59 GiB for the container, leaving 4 GiB for everything else). Set Engine settings to resident-budget-gib=8 (two 32 GB cards) and Parallel requests to 2 unless this server is dedicated to Strata. Single-card servers: see the README before choosing a budget.
Requirements: the amdgpu kernel driver, which Unraid ships as standard (Linux 6.8+) — no driver plugin needed. Pick your card family under Branch when installing: latest-rocm-gfx120x for the RX 9000 series and Radeon AI PRO R9700 (default), latest-rocm-gfx110x for the RX 7000 series, latest-rocm-gfx1151 for Ryzen AI Max (Strix Halo). The RX 6000 series has no image yet. You also need RAM for the model's experts plus about 10 GB: roughly 44 GB (Q2_0), 46 GB (IQ2_XS), 53 GB (IQ3_XXS) or 60 GB (IQ3_S) total, and room for the model on an SSD pool (about 80 GB IQ3_XXS, 90 GB IQ3_S).
First start: downloads the model into the Data folder and prepares it, which takes a while; watch the log. A stopped download resumes where it left off. Later starts go straight to serving. The model name the API serves is listed at http://[IP]:[PORT:8080]/v1/models.
RAM: by default Strata also copies the model's experts into system RAM, even ones the cards already hold — a two-card server used about 59 GiB this way. On a busy server cap it under Engine settings: resident-budget-gib=8 keeps in RAM only what the cards do not hold (about 23 GiB measured, with Parallel requests 2, costing about 9% on cold prompt speed). The model fills the GPU memory too: stop other GPU workloads before starting.
API key: always on. Leave it empty and the first start makes one and keeps it in the Data folder; show it with: docker exec Strata-AMD strata launch --show-key --preset docker. Clients send it as Authorization: Bearer KEY.
Changing settings: the default image tags (latest-rocm-*) follow the maintainer; once your setup is tuned you can pin a version by editing the Repository tag, for example ghcr.io/niko1221/strata:0.2.7-rocm-gfx120x. Edit settings and Apply. The new values replace the saved ones on the next start; the model files and tuning stay in the Data folder.
Template and Unraid problems: the Support link. Strata itself: the Project link.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: llm qwen local ai openai anthropic api inference chat amd rocm radeon rdna gpu
Container.Requires: **amdgpu** kernel driver — Unraid ships it, no driver plugin needed (Linux 6.8+). An RDNA 3 / RDNA 4 / Strix Halo card: RX 7000 series, RX 9000 series, Radeon AI PRO R9700, or Ryzen AI Max — pick the matching **Branch** at install (gfx120x / gfx110x / gfx1151); the RX 6000 series has no image yet. Do not set a memory limit on the container: Strata plans from the server's whole RAM. Do not pin CPUs: the engine sets its own thread affinity.

Config.Name: WebUI / API port
Config.Description: Chat page, monitor and the API (/v1 for OpenAI clients, the root URL for Anthropic clients).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The model, the prepared pack, presets, tuning and the API key: tens of GB, the log names the size. Use a direct pool path (/mnt/cache/... or /mnt/POOLNAME/...), not /mnt/user: the engine reads the model files while it runs. Typical space: about 80 GB (IQ3_XXS), 90 GB (IQ3_S); Unsloth files are bigger (UD-IQ4_XS 94 GB, UD-Q4_K_XL 111 GB downloads). Keep this path stable: pointing it at a new, empty folder starts a full model download again.

Config.Name: GPUs
Config.Description: The cards the engine uses: numbers as Strata lists them (0, or 0,1 to split the model across two). On a server with several cards, name them explicitly rather than leaving all. Every named card must match the card family of the Branch.

Config.Name: GPU roles
Config.Description: Advanced, multi-card only: a role for each card, like 1=main,0=helper. main runs the final stage (the answer head; Strata picks the faster card by default), helper shares the model's layers, off leaves the card alone; cards you do not name are off. Not together with GPUs. Empty: Strata chooses.

Config.Name: Model
Config.Description: Empty: Strata picks the model it recommends for this server and says so in the log. Or a size such as IQ2_XS, IQ3_XXS, IQ3_S or Q2_0; see docs/MODELS.md in the Strata repository for what each needs.

Config.Name: Model family
Config.Description: Empty for the usual one. qwen, swift (thinks shorter) or coder, when the size exists in several families.

Config.Name: Context length
Config.Description: How much text it remembers at once; longer costs RAM. 128k suits chat; agentic clients (for example Hermes) want 256k. The client's configured window must not be larger than this value.

Config.Name: Vision
Config.Description: on: the model reads pictures (about 0.9 GB more to download). gpu or cpu choose where the picture reader runs.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: 16 characters or more (openssl rand -hex 24 makes one). Empty: the first start makes one and keeps it in the Data folder.

Config.Name: Tuning
Config.Description: Measures the best engine settings for this server, once, and keeps them. quick takes up to about 20 minutes on the first start, thorough up to about 2 hours.

Config.Name: Tune again
Config.Description: 1 tunes again on the next start even if this preset is already tuned, for example after an update. Set it back to 0 afterwards.

Config.Name: Parallel requests
Config.Description: Requests answered at the same time, 1 to 8; each extra request costs RAM. 2 is enough for one chat client plus its helper tasks. Empty: fitted to the card (4 on a two-card test server).

Config.Name: KV cache type
Config.Description: Conversation memory format: int8 (default), q4_0 (half the memory), k8v4, fp16.

Config.Name: Existing model folder
Config.Description: Optional: a host folder of GGUF files you already have, mounted read-only at /models. Enter /models in Existing model files below and set Model too; nothing is downloaded for the model itself. Empty: no mount.

Config.Name: Existing model files
Config.Description: GGUF files you already have, as a path inside the container. Add a Path mapping for their folder (read-only is fine), e.g. /models, and enter that here; set Model too. Nothing is downloaded for the model itself.

Config.Name: Engine settings
Config.Description: Advanced engine settings, space separated, like strata launch --set. The most useful one on a shared server: resident-budget-gib=8 caps the experts kept in RAM that the GPUs do not hold (Strata otherwise also copies into RAM the experts the cards already hold). Measured on two 32 GB cards: about 59 GiB for the container uncapped, about 23 GiB capped, at about 9% cost on cold prompt speed. Suits two or more cards; on a single card see the README. Empty: Strata decides.
